topic: Hungary and Great Britain share the record of 3 Olympic men's football gold medals: Hungary in 1952, 1964 and 1968; Great Britain in 1900, 1908 and 1912 (olympics.com; Britannica). Brazil (2016, 2020) and Argentina (2004, 2008) have 2 each; Uruguay and the Soviet Union also 2. Hungary's 1952 Helsinki team, the 'Magical Magyars' of Puskás, Kocsis and Hidegkuti, went unbeaten in 42 consecutive matches from May 1950 to the 1954 World Cup final (FIFA; Britannica). Their home ground was the Népstadion in Budapest (opened 1953; now replaced by the Puskás Aréna). Hungary last qualified for the Olympic men's football tournament in 1972 (silver).
